Regulation: B.C. Reg. 160/2026
Made under: Provincial Sales Tax Act
Published in: No. 16 – B.C. Regs. 153 to 162, September 22, including September 8, 2026
Deposit date: September 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 160/2026, deposited September 22, 2026, under thePROVINCIAL SALES TAX ACT[section 240]. Order in Council 407/2026, approved and ordered September 21, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, (a)	effective November 1, 2026, the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 1, and (b)	effective January 1, 2027, the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 2. — J. OSBORNE,Minister of Finance; J. WHITESIDE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Schedule 1 of the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended (a)	in column 4 of item 19 by striking out "November 1, 2026" and substituting "November 1, 2031", (b)	in column 4 of item 23 by striking out "January 1, 2027" and substituting "January 1, 2032", and (c)	in column 4 of item 32 by striking out "November 1, 2026" and substituting "November 1, 2031". 2	The table in Schedule 2 is amended in column 4 of item 24 by striking out "January 1, 2027" and substituting "January 1, 2032". (a)	in section 2 by striking out "and" at the end of paragraph (a), by adding ", and" at the end of paragraph (b) and by adding the following paragraph: (c)	improvements to lighting to enhance downtown Victoria for tourists and other visitors., and (b)	by adding the following section: 10The Harrison Tourism Society may spend the money paid to it for planning and supporting a transportation project to ensure safe cycling infrastructure. 1	The table in Schedule 2 of the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended (a)	in column 4 of item 5 by striking out "February 1, 2029" and substituting "January 1, 2032", (b)	in column 2 of item 6 by striking out "Radium Hot Springs Chamber of Commerce" and substituting "Columbia Valley Tourism Marketing Society", (c)	in column 4 of item 6 by striking out "August 1, 2027" and substituting "January 1, 2032", (d)	in column 4 of item 22 by striking out "January 1, 2027" and substituting "January 1, 2032", and (e)	by adding the following items as indicated:

minutes_briefs.title: BC extends hotel room tax (accommodation tax) end dates for several tourist areas to 2031 and 2032
minutes_briefs.summary: BC has changed the end dates for the designated accommodation area tax (a small tax added to hotel and short-term rental bills in certain tourist areas) in several communities. Under B.C. Reg. 160/2026, the tax in some areas now runs until November 1, 2031 or January 1, 2032 instead of ending in late 2026 or 2027. The regulation also changes which group collects the tax in one area and lets two tourism groups spend the money on new things: downtown Victoria lighting and Harrison-area safe cycling paths.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check whether your accommodation business is in an affected area and update your booking system, invoices and tax remittance to reflect the new end dates.

key_dates.label: BC accommodation area tax end-date extensions take effect
BC accommodation area tax further changes take effect
